dataset: poidh v2 (Arbitrum One) wallet-level ETH flows + NFT holdings

reconciliation.sum_parts_check: all 180 bounty pots equal sum of on-chain participantAmounts (0 mismatches)
reconciliation.fee_identity: fee = amount*25//1000 (2.5%); fee*40 == amount for all 112 completed bounties
reconciliation.nft_reconciliation: 112 NFTs held by wallets + 325 held by the bounty contract = totalSupply 437
reconciliation.note: Bounty contract ETH balance is 0 while 24 open bounties carry 0.02485801 ETH of unclaimed amount; a simulated withdrawFromOpenBounty() reverts transferFailed. Settled (completed) flows are unaffected: every acceptance in the contract code requires amount <= balance and pays amount-fee + fee atomically.

methodology.enumeration: getBountiesLength() -> 180; bounties(i) for i in [0,180) via Multicall3.aggregate3 (30 calls/batch); getParticipants(i) and getClaimsByBountyId(i) likewise; ownerOf(tokenId) for every tokenId in [0, totalSupply) on the NFT contract. All reads are eth_call at one pinned block; no eth_getLogs, no indexer, no explorer.
methodology.completed_bounty: claimer != 0x0 AND claimer != issuer AND the linked claim (bounties(i).claimId) has accepted == true and issuer == claimer.
methodology.refunds_excluded: cancelSoloBounty/cancelOpenBounty set claimer = issuer; those 44 bounties (0.24255493 ETH) are excluded from paid_out/earned.
methodology.eth_paid_out: Per completed bounty, the pot is attributed to its contributors: the participantAmounts[] split for open bounties (issuer is participant[0], withdrawn participants are zeroed on-chain), or the full amount to the issuer for solo bounties. Sum of contributions equals the pot for all 180 bounties.
methodology.eth_earned: Gross amount paid to the accepted claimer = bounty.amount at settlement (the contract does not zero amount in _acceptClaim). Contract: fee = amount*25/1000, payout = amount - fee, both sent in the same tx. Gross == fee*40 exactly.
methodology.nft_count: Current holdings, not mints: poidh v2 NFTs (tokenId == claimId) are minted to the bounty contract and transferred to the bounty issuer on acceptance; ownerOf() is read for all 437 tokens, so later transfers are reflected.
methodology.verification: Re-run poidh_v2_arb_enumerate.py then poidh_v2_arb_build.py against any Arbitrum RPC.
